issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo contains no story corpus or generator, so tiny demo and tests fail from a clean checkout.
End-to-end test depends on missing repo data and currently fails before validating the pipeline.
Advertised demo command is not runnable because extract immediately requires absent story data.
HF model is initialized before local config/data validation, so a full run may download/load a large model before failing on missing files.
Validation trusts loaded vector artifacts and builds a backend from current CLI config without checking manifest backend, layer count, or d_model compatibility.
Preference steering also mixes manifest-loaded vectors with the current backend without shape or backend compatibility validation.
Token averaging uses halfway fallback when seq_len equals token_start, contradicting the documented shorter-than-requested behavior.
A duplicate token-start calculation repeats the same off-by-one fallback behavior and can record misleading effective starts.
HF preference scoring is a single-prompt good-vs-bad logit heuristic, not the pairwise preference comparison described by the README.
A PCA threshold of 0 is accepted but still returns one component, making it impossible to configure no neutral-PC projection via threshold.
Custom emotion configs with no matching built-in scenarios produce an empty stack/opaque failure instead of a clear validation error.
pytest is only in the optional test extra, but the README test instructions do not tell users to install that extra.
Documentation claims the tiny CPU demo runs, but the checked-out repo cannot execute it because required stories are absent.
